description: Append one chunk of a file into the server-side File Workspace. Use this to push files too big to emit in one response: call it repeatedly with small chunks of the same file (and other files), then call workspace_push once. Omit workspace_id on the very first chunk to get a fresh id back, then reuse that id for every chunk and every file in the push.

content.description: One chunk of the file's UTF-8 content.

path.description: Repo-relative file path this chunk belongs to.

seq.description: Optional explicit chunk order. Defaults to append order.

workspace_id.description: Omit on the first chunk to receive a fresh id; reuse it for all chunks and files in one push.

name: workspace_put
title: Stage a file chunk (Large-PR Room)
